name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (audio/SFX domain). Descriptor accurately states the behaviour: play a one-shot SFX sample resolved from a sample-bank directory. No Ghidra address residue in the name. It is the sample-slot-1 sibling of fd2_play_sfx_with_handle (slot 0); the existing name distinguishes it adequately without needing a slot suffix.
purpose: One-shot AIL/Miles SFX player that plays a sample (resolved from a sample-bank directory) on SFX sample slot 1.
logic_summary: Returns silently unless all three gates hold: sfx driver available (0x53EF1)!=0, sfx enabled (0x51E62)!=0, scripted-cinematic/terrain flag (0x540FF)==0. Always AIL_stop_sample(handle_1) first; if sfx_id==0xFFFFFFFF returns (stop-only). Otherwise resolves entry = bank_ptr + sfx_id*4; reads sample_offset = *(entry+6) and sample_end = *(entry+10); then AIL_init_sample, AIL_set_sample_address(handle_1, bank_ptr+sample_offset, sample_end-sample_offset), AIL_set_sample_loop_count(handle_1, loop_count), AIL_start_sample(handle_1). Same control flow as fd2_play_sfx_with_handle but driving slot 1 instead of slot 0, so an SFX here can play without cutting one on the other channel.
signature: void fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank(uint32 bank_ptr, uint32 sfx_id, uint32 loop_count)

params.name: bank_ptr
params.semantics: Base pointer/address of the sample bank. Used both as the directory base (entry = bank_ptr + sfx_id*4) and as the addend for the resolved sample data address (bank_ptr + sample_offset).
params.reason: Accurately names the sample-bank base pointer; matches body usage; no address residue.

params.name: sfx_id
params.semantics: Sample index into the bank directory (4-byte stride). The value 0xFFFFFFFF is a sentinel meaning stop-only (return after the leading AIL_stop_sample).
params.reason: Clear domain-appropriate name for the sample index; matches usage and the -1 stop sentinel; no address residue.

params.name: loop_count
params.semantics: Loop-count argument forwarded verbatim to AIL_set_sample_loop_count for the started sample.
params.reason: Accurately describes the value passed to AIL_set_sample_loop_count; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect is starting (or stopping) playback on AIL SFX sample slot 1; silent no-op when any gate fails or on the stop-only sfx_id==-1 path.

notes: src comment block (audio.c lines 186-214) is accurate, precise and ASCII-clean: it documents the slot-1 role and the contrast vs fd2_play_sfx_with_handle (slot 0), the three gates with addresses, the -1 stop-only path, the entry+6/entry+10 directory layout, and the compiler-injected __CHK(0x1c)/PUSH-POP EBX. Ghidra plate is semantically consistent (no contradiction), so no plate edit. Global names used in src are byte-identical to the decompile output (in sync). Ghidra decompile shows a redundant sample_offset/sample_offset2 pair reading entry+6 (signed vs unsigned for the subtraction) -- that is a Ghidra artifact, not a real defect; src correctly uses one sample_offset. No logic concern. Name rename not applied here per workflow (Stage 2 handles renames); verdict is keep regardless.
